why: Space la vung quet quanh canh va cham da dung: xe dap xuat phat 10-30 m truoc ego (ego bat dau tai x=-40, va cham mau tai x=-20); d=1.3-1.5 m dat xe dap sat mep lan E2 truoc khi lang vao; v=3-5 m/s va trigger 15-25 m la cac khoang canh bao duoc quet quanh ca thu. Swerve toi da 4 m trong toi thieu 2.7 s tao gia toc ngang cuc dai pi^2*4/(2*2.7^2)=2.71 m/s^2, duoi gioi han 3 m/s^2 cua studio. Exposure=0.05, tuong ung 1/20 chuyen tren tuyen qua cong truong. O gio den va tan hoc, hoc sinh qua lai cung xe dap di sat mep lan; nguoi di xe dap co the lang vao lan ego de tranh nguoi qua duong hoac xe dung do.
